Odama is hatching a plan to restore Colony 6.[XENO:n ]
To begin with, the refugees from the camp need to be[XENO:n ]
brought back. To do this, they need safe passage.

Defeat the monsters on Raguel Bridge on the[XENO:n ]
Giant God's Leg to ensure the refugees' safe passage.

Defeat the additional monsters that appeared to[XENO:n ]
make Raguel Bridge safe once more.

Report back to Juujuu in the Refugee Camp on the[XENO:n ]
Giant God's Leg.

The refugees can return home safely. Now the[XENO:n ]
restoration of Colony 6 can begin in earnest.

The plan to restore Colony 6 is progressing.[XENO:n ]
To begin with, the refugees from the camp need to be[XENO:n ]
brought back. To do this, they need safe passage.

Defeat the monsters on Raguel Bridge on the[XENO:n ]
Giant God's Leg to ensure the refugees' safe passage.

Defeat the additional monsters that appeared to[XENO:n ]
make Raguel Bridge safe once more.

Report back to Juujuu in the Refugee Camp on the[XENO:n ]
Giant God's Leg.

The refugees can return home safely. Now the[XENO:n ]
restoration of Colony 6 can begin in earnest.

Hoko's cuisine is so foul that it's putting customers off.[XENO:n ]
For Hoko to beat his rival, he'll need fresh ingredients.

Collect 3 lots of [System:Color name=item ]Thick Armu Milk[/System:Color] from Armus[XENO:n ]
on the Giant God's Leg.

Collect 3 [System:Color name=item ]White Brog Livers[/System:Color] from Brogs[XENO:n ]
in Satorl Marsh.

Collect [System:Color name=item ]Juicy Wild Meat[/System:Color] from 3 Stella Eks[XENO:n ]
at Eryth Sea.
Report back to Hoko.

Trade has picked up as Hoko's cuisine is edging[XENO:n ]
closer to the quality of Tatedonas's.

Hoko's cuisine has come leaps and bounds and now[XENO:n ]
his sights are set on bettering Tatedonas. Time to[XENO:n ]
gather more ingredients to help him achieve this goal.
Collect 4[System:Color name=item ] Charcoal Legs[/System:Color] from the Ether Mine.
Collect 4 [System:Color name=item ]Honey Rhubarbs[/System:Color] from Makna Forest.
Collect 4 [System:Color name=item ]Tropical Radishes[/System:Color] from Eryth Sea.
Report back to Hoko.

Hoko's cuisine is now not only better than[XENO:n ]
Tatedonas's, but is the best in Colony 6!

Tatedonas is bitter about Hoko's becoming the[XENO:n ]
better cook. Now he wants your support.

Collect a [System:Color name=item ]Sky Frying Pan[/System:Color] from near Sky Stage[XENO:n ]
on the Giant God's Leg.
Return to Tatedonas.

Collect the [System:Color name=item ]Nature's Stove[/System:Color] from near the Eks[XENO:n ]
Watering Hole in Makna Forest.
Return to Tatedonas.

Tatedonas is back on form with his cuisine and[XENO:n ]
the Colony 6 cuisine rivalry is as fierce as ever.

Myxilia was a fan of the cuisine Hoko used to make,[XENO:n ]
and can't bear to eat anything else. Get Hoko to whip[XENO:n ]
up a dish in his old style of cooking.
Speak to Hoko.

Collect 2 [System:Color name=item ]Soya Paste Shells[/System:Color] from Entma Kings[XENO:n ]
on Valak Mountain.
Report back to Hoko.

Collect 2 [System:Color name=item ]Soya Paste Shells[/System:Color] from Entma Kings[XENO:n ]
on Valak Mountain.
Report back to Hoko.
Report back to Myxilia.

Hoko's old style of cuisine may not suit everyone,[XENO:n ]
but there's one patron who's very happy.

While Hoko vies for the top spot, Myxilia has[XENO:n ]
decided to start making her own cuisine.

Connoisseur Pokapoka craves a Homs speciality.[XENO:n ]
To meet his demands, bring him the requested dish.

Collect 3 [System:Color name=item ]Bunnia Hams[/System:Color] from Ether Bunnia[XENO:n ]
in Satorl Marsh.
Report back to Pokapoka.

The cravings of connoisseur Pokapoka are now[XENO:n ]
satisfied thanks to the delicacies you gathered.

Connoisseur Pokapoka craves a special delicacy.[XENO:n ]
To meet his demands, bring him the odd dish.

Collect 3 [System:Color name=item ]Pagul Cold Pies[/System:Color] from Sparas Paguls on[XENO:n ]
Valak Mountain.
Report back to Pokapoka.

The 'special' taste of the pie is similar to Hoko's[XENO:n ]
old cuisine, but strangely addictive.

Nopo'rikh, a Nopon who was living with Myxilia,[XENO:n ]
hasn't returned home. Locate his whereabouts.
Locate the missing Nopo'rikh.
Return to Myxilia.

Nopo'rikh has returned to Myxilia but something[XENO:n ]
suggests things aren't going well.

Desperate to escape the domineering High Entia girl,[XENO:n ]
Nopo'rikh needs your help but don't let Myxilia know.

Collect some [System:Color name=item ]Smelly Perfume[/System:Color] from the Poison[XENO:n ]
Swamp in Satorl Marsh. Or perhaps...?
Hand it to Nopo'rikh.

Collect some [System:Color name=item ]Pure Perfume[/System:Color] from[XENO:n ]
Great Makna Falls in Makna Forest.
Hand it to Nopo'rikh.
Return to Myxilia.

Nopo'rikh's free at last! Now he can live free and[XENO:n ]
easy in his favourite thicket.

Nopo'rikh's plans have fallen through due to[XENO:n ]
Myxilia's relentless doting on him.

Before something terrible befalls a close friend of[XENO:n ]
Nora, gather the ingredients for her so she can[XENO:n ]
make some medicine.

Collect 4 lots of [System:Color name=item ]Thick Nectar[/System:Color] from Skeeters on[XENO:n ]
the Giant God's Leg.
Collect 4 [System:Color name=item ]Juicy Grapes[/System:Color] from Makna Forest.
Return to Nora.

Nora and Pyral's joint efforts have resulted in[XENO:n ]
a medicine to help cure Nora's friend's illness.

Nora needs medicine for her friend, but her[XENO:n ]
teacher's advice isn't making this easy. Follow her[XENO:n ]
teacher's instructions and help get the medicine ready.
Speak to Mefimefi.

Collect the [System:Color name=item ]Statue Fragment[/System:Color] from the Sororal[XENO:n ]
Statues in Satorl Marsh.
Hand the ingredient to Mefimefi.
Return to Nora.

Mefimefi's magic worked and you've got the[XENO:n ]
medicine. Nora's friend is certain to recover.

Strojam won't drink the medicine Nora made,[XENO:n ]
which means she's not going to recover.[XENO:n ]
Use everyone to convince her to drink it.
Convince Strojam.
Return to Nora.

Strojam is susceptible to gruff men, so[XENO:n ]
Dunban was able to convince her to drink it.

Strojam has been drinking Nora's medicine[XENO:n ]
as if it's juice. Now she's in a very bad state.[XENO:n ]
Do something to stop her.

Either discuss Strojam's condition with[XENO:n ]
Nora or give her some of Olga's medicine.

Collect 3 lots of [System:Color name=item ]Caterpile Vinegar[/System:Color] from Satorl[XENO:n ]
Caterpiles in Satorl Marsh.
Return to Nora.
Return to Strojam.

Strojam has started drinking the medicine[XENO:n ]
correctly and should be on the road to recovery.

Strojam's medicine dependence has passed,[XENO:n ]
but she still suffers from her previous illness.

Who will become the undisputed Miss Sweetness of[XENO:n ]
Colony 6? Deliver the requested item to Strojam.
Collect the world's most transparent thing.
Report back to Strojam.

The undisputed Miss Sweetness of Colony 6 has[XENO:n ]
been decided. Strojam has beaten Myxilia.

Who will become the undisputed Miss Sweetness of[XENO:n ]
Colony 6? Deliver the requested item to Myxilia.
Collect the world's most transparent thing.
Return to Myxilia.

The undisputed Miss Sweetness of Colony 6 has[XENO:n ]
been decided. Myxilia has beaten Strojam.

To become undisputed Miss Sweetness of Colony 6,[XENO:n ]
entrants must collect certain themed objects.[XENO:n ]
Collect the most transparent thing in the world.
Speak to Rapan in Frontier Village.
Speak to Dakuku on Valak Mountain.

Collect a [System:Color name=item ]Pure Ice Flower[/System:Color] from near Url Crevasse[XENO:n ]
on Valak Mountain.

A Pure Ice Flower, the most transparent thing in[XENO:n ]
the world. Take it to the person who requested it.

Help Strojam, the undisputed Miss Sweetness of[XENO:n ]
Colony 6, to thank the colony residents.
Listen to her demands.
Return to Strojam.

To show her gratitude, the lakeside area will be[XENO:n ]
populated with relaxing and tranquil lights.

Help Myxilia, the undisputed Miss Sweetness of[XENO:n ]
Colony 6, to thank the colony residents.
Listen to her demands.
Return to Myxilia.

To show her gratitude, fireflies now appear[XENO:n ]
above the lake at night.

Although things aren't very clear, you're to pay a visit[XENO:n ]
to Frontier Village and get instructions from Rapan.
Talk to Rapan in Frontier Village.

Collect [System:Color name=item ]Fresh Algora Sap[/System:Color] from the Sap Cave in[XENO:n ]
Makna Forest. (Only at dawn.)
Talk to Rapan in Frontier Village again.

Collect a [System:Color name=item ]Mysterious Droplet[/System:Color] from near Lacus[XENO:n ]
Swamp in Satorl Marsh.

Now you have the Mysterious Droplet and Fresh[XENO:n ]
Algora Sap, deliver them to Miss Sweetness.

To make good on the promise you made when you[XENO:n ]
invited Rosewest to Colony 6, find her a suitor.
Find a timid Homs man.
Find a rough-and-ready Homs man.
Find a composed High Entia.
Find a Nopon food connoisseur.
Return to Rosewest.

Rosewest was satisfied with two of the suitors[XENO:n ]
you picked - Nic and Yuuri.

Nic seemed to be in good spirits after meeting[XENO:n ]
Rosewest. He wants to give her a gift, but needs[XENO:n ]
some help gathering the materials. Help him out.

Collect 2 [System:Color name=item ]Eks Iron Hearts[/System:Color] from Makna Eks[XENO:n ]
in Makna Forest.
Return to Nic.
Give the [System:Color name=item ]Music Box[/System:Color] to Rosewest.
Return to Nic.

Nic confessed his love for Rosewest, who in turn[XENO:n ]
is attracted to quirky Nic. The two are an item.

Yuuri seemed to be in good spirits after meeting[XENO:n ]
Rosewest. He'd like to get to know her better and is[XENO:n ]
thinking of giving her something special. Help him out.

Collect the [System:Color name=item ]Swan Pendant[/System:Color] from the[XENO:n ]
High Entia Tomb.
Return to Yuuri.
Give the [System:Color name=item ]Swan Pendant[/System:Color] to Rosewest.
Return to Yuuri.

Yuuri's feelings have resonated with Rosewest[XENO:n ]
and the two have developed a close relationship.

While Zel Silver meets with a friend, she wants[XENO:n ]
you to keep her father company.
Have a chat with Don Silver.
Have another chat with Don Silver.
Have a chat with Don Silver once again.
Have yet another chat with Don Silver.
Return to Zel Silver.

It turns out it was all a diversion so that[XENO:n ]
Zel Silver could see her boyfriend.

While En Silver meets with a friend, she wants[XENO:n ]
you to keep her father company.
Have a chat with Don Silver.
Have another chat with Don Silver.
Have a chat with Don Silver once again.
Have yet another chat with Don Silver.
Return to En Silver.

En is pleased you were able to distract her father[XENO:n ]
long enough that she could see her boyfriend.

Zel Silver' father has found out about her and[XENO:n ]
Orkhong and isn't pleased. The only way to make him[XENO:n ]
see reason is to meet his unreasonable demands.

Collect 5 [System:Color name=item ]Scratched Jewels[/System:Color] from Perna Eluca[XENO:n ]
at Eryth Sea.

Collect 2 [System:Color name=item ]Lucky Chilkin Rings[/System:Color] from Chilkins on[XENO:n ]
Valak Mountain.
Hand the items to Orkhong.

Don Silver' stubbornness hasn't subsided[XENO:n ]
and he still opposes the pair being together.

En Silver' father has found out about her and[XENO:n ]
Pepii and isn't pleased. The only way to make him[XENO:n ]
see reason is to meet his unreasonable demands.

Collect 2 [System:Color name=item ]Slobos Ice Rocks[/System:Color] from Sloboses on[XENO:n ]
Valak Mountain.

Collect 2 [System:Color name=item ]Wisp Bliss Rings[/System:Color] from Wisps[XENO:n ]
on Fallen Arm.
Hand the items to Pepii.

Don Silver' stubbornness hasn't subsided[XENO:n ]
and he still opposes the pair being together.

Don Silver was so opposed to Zel Silver and[XENO:n ]
Orkhong's relationship that they decided to run away.[XENO:n ]
Find the missing couple.
Search the Satorl Marsh area for the couple.
Persuade Orkhong.
Return to Don Silver.

Don Silver has overcome his stubbornness[XENO:n ]
and given Zel and Orkhong his blessing.

Don Silver was so opposed to En Silver and[XENO:n ]
Pepii's relationship that they decided to run away.[XENO:n ]
Find the missing couple.
Search the Tephra Cave area for the couple.
Return to Don Silver.

Don Silver has overcome his stubbornness[XENO:n ]
and given En and Pepii his blessing.

Butler Gowagowa is concerned that Strojam isn't[XENO:n ]
studying enough. Convince Yuuri to become her tutor.
Hand the [System:Color name=item ]Poetry Anthology[/System:Color] to Yuuri.
Return to Gowagowa.

The first-rate butler's request worked out[XENO:n ]
perfectly and Yuuri is now Strojam's tutor.

Minka the maid is concerned that Strojam isn't[XENO:n ]
studying enough. Find someone to be her tutor.
Search for a cultured individual.
Collect 5 [System:Color name=item ]Hell Raspberries[/System:Color] from Prison Island.
Return to Yuuri.
Return to Minka.

Yuuri has been convinced to become[XENO:n ]
Strojam's tutor.

Naonami seems to have almost given up on her life.[XENO:n ]
Find something to revitalise her.
Find something to revitalise Naonami.
Return to Naonami.

The Pterix Energy Egg was just what Naonami[XENO:n ]
needed to perk her up and extend her life span.

The Machina Energy was just what Naonami[XENO:n ]
needed to perk her up a little.

Yuuri wants to write a poem about Naonami, but she[XENO:n ]
needs a little convincing before she's willing to comply.[XENO:n ]
Persuade Naonami to accept his proposal.
Talk to Naonami.

Collect a [System:Color name=item ]Tobogan Wing[/System:Color] from Hovering Reef 9[XENO:n ]
at Eryth Sea.
Hand the [System:Color name=item ]Tobogan Wing[/System:Color] to Naonami.
Return to Yuuri.

Naonami let Yuuri write a poem about her. This[XENO:n ]
collaboration will likely lead to amazing results.

Theta Cross needs to make a delivery but can't read the[XENO:n ]
details of the recipients. Decipher the hints and get the[XENO:n ]
delivery to the actual recipient.

Take the [System:Color name=item ]delivery[/System:Color] to a person whose name[XENO:n ]
ends in 'n'.
Return to Theta Cross.

Make the [System:Color name=item ]delivery[/System:Color] on behalf of Theta Cross to[XENO:n ]
a 16-year-old girl.
Return to Theta Cross.

The deliveries were successfully made.[XENO:n ]
Theta Cross ought to be pleased.

Theta Cross, a jack-of-all-trades, has foolishly agreed to find[XENO:n ]
a legendary vegetable for someone. Locate the item[XENO:n ]
on his behalf.
Collect 2 [System:Color name=item ]Energy Aubergines[/System:Color] from somewhere.
Return to Theta Cross.

You've completed Theta Cross's job for him. Most[XENO:n ]
importantly, his customer was not disappointed.

Every night, smoke comes from a door near[XENO:n ]
Arda's house. To put her mind at ease, find[XENO:n ]
out what's causing it.

Speak to the owner of the house where[XENO:n ]
the smoke is coming from.
Report back to Arda.

The smoke comes from Jericon's experiments.[XENO:n ]
Despite the obnoxious colour, it's harmless.

It turns out Jericon was lying. The equipment she's[XENO:n ]
using is broken and that's what's producing the[XENO:n ]
smoke. Gather materials to repair the equipment.

Collect 3 [System:Color name=item ]Dated Plugs[/System:Color] from old flying Mechon[XENO:n ]
on the Fallen Arm.

Collect 3 [System:Color name=item ]Dated Cranks[/System:Color] from old scout Mechon[XENO:n ]
on the Fallen Arm.
Return to Jericon.

The smoke billowing from Jericon's house is no[XENO:n ]
longer a worry for the residents of Colony 6.

Jericon told Pyral that Armus are good-for-nothing[XENO:n ]
creatures and laughed at her proposal. Help Pyral[XENO:n ]
show Jericon what being Homs means.
Defeat 8 [System:Color name=item ]Sloth Gogols[/System:Color] on the Giant God's Leg.

Defeat [System:Color name=item ]Territorial Rotbart[/System:Color] on Gaur Plain on[XENO:n ]
the Giant God's Leg.
Return to Pyral.

With the Armus' natural enemies vanquished,[XENO:n ]
Pyral has earned Jericon's respect.

Jericon told Mefimefi that Armus do nothing but graze.[XENO:n ]
Help Mefimefi show what Armus are capable of and[XENO:n ]
prove that Nopon know a thing or two!
Collect 5 [System:Color name=item ]Spicy Papayas[/System:Color] from the Fallen Arm.
Collect 2 [System:Color name=item ]Broom Icicles[/System:Color] from Valak Mountain.

Collect 3 [System:Color name=item ]Igna Stone Pots[/System:Color] from Ignas in Satorl[XENO:n ]
Marsh.
Report back to Mefimefi.

Mefimefi has gained the Armu's respect with food[XENO:n ]
and also her colleague Jericon's respect.

Werner wants to use the many butterflies in the[XENO:n ]
flower garden to make a special product.[XENO:n ]
Collect items for him to make his Colony 6 speciality.
Collect 6 [System:Color name=item ]Flier Wings[/System:Color] from the Fliers in Colony 6.

Collect 7 [System:Color name=item ]Flier Straws[/System:Color] from Fliers on the Giant God's[XENO:n ]
Leg.
Return to Werner.

Werner has started selling butterfly products.[XENO:n ]
Will they take Colony 6 by storm though?

The famous butterflies of Colony 6 seem to have left.[XENO:n ]
Find a way to entice them back. There are rumours[XENO:n ]
a Nopon might know how to accomplish this task.

Consult Nopon residents in Colony 6 about how[XENO:n ]
to bring back the butterflies.
Collect 5 [System:Color name=item ]Mystic Dahlias[/System:Color] from Achamoth.
Return to Nora.
Collect 10 [System:Color name=item ]Death Lychees[/System:Color] on Prison Island.
Return to Nopo'rikh.
Return to Werner.

The butterflies are back thanks to Nora's[XENO:n ]
insight. Werner can sell his goods once more.

The butterflies are back thanks to Nopo'rikh's[XENO:n ]
dance. Werner can sell his goods once more.

Nopo'rikh's concerned about his disciplined training[XENO:n ]
plan. Determine which is the more difficult.

Defeat [System:Color name=item ]Canyon Valencia[/System:Color] near Raguel Bridge on[XENO:n ]
the Giant God's Leg. (Only during clear weather.)
Return to Nopo'rikh.
Defeat 10 [System:Color name=item ]Tempest Vangs[/System:Color] on the Giant God's Leg.
Return to Nopo'rikh.

The training plan for Nic has been decided.[XENO:n ]
It's likely he'll go from strength to strength now.

Nopo'rikh's concerned about the final stage of the[XENO:n ]
training. Determine which is the more difficult.

Defeat [System:Color name=item ]Indomitable Daulton[/System:Color] near the Soter Ruins[XENO:n ]
in Satorl Marsh.
Return to Nopo'rikh.
Defeat 10 [System:Color name=item ]Grove Quadwings[/System:Color] from Satorl Marsh.
Return to Nopo'rikh.

Nic's final test has been chosen. Completing[XENO:n ]
this will place him a cut above the rest.

Ewan's worried because he doesn't know how to write[XENO:n ]
a romantic novel. Speak to people who know about[XENO:n ]
such things and pass their advice on to Ewan.
Speak to an old Nopon inventor.

Speak to a Homs lady who understands[XENO:n ]
medicine.
Speak to a stubborn old Homs man.
Speak to a haughty young Homs girl.
Report back to Ewan.

Having overcome his inability to write romance,[XENO:n ]
Ewan decided to confess his love for Matryona.

Ewan channelled his feelings of love into his novel, but[XENO:n ]
couldn't hand it over. He'll go on an adventure to gain[XENO:n ]
the courage to do so, but might need some protection.

Head in the direction of the Ether Mine or Satorl[XENO:n ]
Marsh and protect Ewan from harm.
Speak to Ewan.
Speak to Ewan.

The adventure helped build his courage and[XENO:n ]
now he's ready to confess his love to Matryona.

The adventure helped build his courage and[XENO:n ]
now he's ready to confess his love to Matryona.

Matryona wants to send her reply to Ewan in the form[XENO:n ]
of a painting, but she needs the right tools to do so.[XENO:n ]
Gather the materials she needs.

Collect a [System:Color name=item ]Lake Drop[/System:Color] on the Giant God's Leg or[XENO:n ]
a [System:Color name=item ]Nasty Weed[/System:Color] in Satorl Marsh.
Hand item to Matryona.
Hand the portrait to Ewan.
Hand item to Matryona.
Hand the portrait to Ewan.
Return to Matryona.

Matryona's stunning portrait, made with the item[XENO:n ]
you found, has brought Ewan and her together.

Matryona produced a hideous portrait which[XENO:n ]
she used to dump Ewan.

Thanks to Anna's selfishness, Nikita and Kiroro[XENO:n ]
headed into the mine and now they're in danger.[XENO:n ]
Find them and get them to safety.
Find Nikita.
Find Kiroro.
Report back to Anna.

Anna realised her mistake and won't make it[XENO:n ]
again. All three are happy and safe once more.

Olga wants to reopen her Colony 6 chemist's. Setting[XENO:n ]
up shop isn't a problem, but getting ingredients is.[XENO:n ]
Find the ingredients for her all-purpose medicine.
Collect a [System:Color name=item ]Chewy Radish[/System:Color] from Colony 9.
Collect 2 [System:Color name=item ]Red Durians[/System:Color] on the Giant God's Leg.
Collect a [System:Color name=item ]Sirius Anemone[/System:Color] in Colony 6.
Report back to Olga.

Olga finished her all-purpose medicine.[XENO:n ]
Now she can reopen her chemist's.

Tatsu has misplaced his younger brother's keepsake.[XENO:n ]
Head to the Ether Mine and retrieve it.

Collect the [System:Color name=item ]Mushroom Cap[/System:Color] from the Mining Base[XENO:n ]
in the Ether Mine.
Return to Tatsu.

Tatsu's younger brother's keepsake has been[XENO:n ]
found. His memory has been honoured.

Tatsu wants to place the keepsake in the same spot[XENO:n ]
as his brother and his brother's wife. Find a spot[XENO:n ]
where Great Makna Falls can be viewed completely.

Cast the Mushroom Cap from where a panoramic[XENO:n ]
view of Great Makna Falls can be seen.
Return to Tatsu.

You threw the cap from the Divine Sanctuary.[XENO:n ]
Tatsu's brother and his wife can rest in peace.

According to Gorman, before Colony 6 can be safely[XENO:n ]
restored to its former glory, a ceremony has to take[XENO:n ]
place. Find a suitable rock.

Collect the [System:Color name=item ]Divine Rock[/System:Color] from the top of Spiral[XENO:n ]
Valley on the Giant God's Leg.
Return to Gorman.

The ceremony was successful and the residents[XENO:n ]
can rest safe knowing the land has been blessed.

A fierce monster is occupying Spiral Valley. If the[XENO:n ]
boulders can be destroyed, an alternative route can be[XENO:n ]
made to avoid it. Hand the Dynamite to Gorman.
Collect 3 sticks of [System:Color name=item ]Dynamite[/System:Color] from the Ether Mine.
Report back to Gorman.

Spiral Valley has a new route and the monster[XENO:n ]
can be avoided by sneaking past it.

Durand may have saved the High Entia refugees by[XENO:n ]
letting them stay in the camp, but there's a problem.[XENO:n ]
Retrieve the provisions stored in Tephra Cave.

Collect the [System:Color name=item ]Trader's Spare Key[/System:Color] from near the[XENO:n ]
Trader's Stopover in Tephra Cave.

Collect the [System:Color name=item ]Emergency Rations[/System:Color] from the Trader's[XENO:n ]
Emergency Warehouse in Tephra Cave.

Report back to Durand near the Refugee Camp[XENO:n ]
on the Giant God's Leg.

Now there should be plenty of food for the[XENO:n ]
High Entia refugees living in the camp.

Daza's proof of Nopon Merchant status was stolen by[XENO:n ]
some Hoxes. They were seen heading in the direction[XENO:n ]
of Splintered Path. See if you can find the item.

Find a [System:Color name=item ]Nopon Coin[/System:Color] in the area of Colony 6's[XENO:n ]
Splintered Path.
Return to Daza.

Daza has his proof of Nopon Merchant status[XENO:n ]
back so he can resume trading.

Daza's fearful his proof of merchant status will be[XENO:n ]
taken again. To be able to resolve the problem, first[XENO:n ]
you need to make the area safe by clearing monsters.
Defeat 4 [System:Color name=item ]Yellow Antols[/System:Color] in Colony 6.
Defeat 6 [System:Color name=item ]Soft Hoxes[/System:Color] in Colony 6.

Defeat 3 [System:Color name=item ]Water Upas[/System:Color] in Colony 6. (Only during[XENO:n ]
rain or a thunderstorm.)
Return to Daza.

The Nopon Merchant's enemies have been[XENO:n ]
defeated. It should be safer now.

You have a top-secret mission from Daza. He wants[XENO:n ]
you to deliver a letter to Grelee.

Take [System:Color name=item ]Daza's Letter[/System:Color] to Grelee who is on the[XENO:n ]
Giant God's Leg.
Return to Daza.

Daza and Grelee are conducting a secret[XENO:n ]
investigation. It's about something red...

The Machina have design plans for five more Replica[XENO:n ]
